# Model-visible context accounting

Status: accepted for the next candidate, not included in sealed beb.

Real P8 evidence showed frequent automatic compaction while reported context was about 32–40k tokens. PI convertToLlm preserves tool details for the runtime; the provider serializer sends content only. Serializing the full internal object for estimation therefore charged a UI mirror as another input.

Project explicit message content and tool identity before conservative byte counting. Keep all content block data, image reserves, tools and output headroom. Do not alter stored history or the SDK request. The existing final physical payload check remains authoritative and rejects unexpected growth. This preserves protection while removing the confirmed duplicate. The method identifier changes to version 3 so diagnostics do not confuse prior estimates.

A real SDK loopback test proves equal payloads with and without 800KB of mirrored details and negative tests prove actual content and wire growth remain blocked. No provider request, disabled protection or guessed larger model window is involved. Re-running the actual model task requires the parent approval/budget gate; this change alone does not prove task completion.
